title: Pathing Plus
description:
NEW: Pathing Plus is now in Simplified and Traditional Chinese (简体中文 / 繁體中文)! The translation is brand new, so if you play in Chinese, please let me know in the comments if anything reads wrong or awkward.
现已支持简体中文！翻译刚刚完成，欢迎在评论区指出任何不准确或不自然的地方。
現已支援繁體中文！翻譯剛完成，歡迎在留言區指出任何不準確或不自然的地方。

Pathing Plus is designed to help you draw better paths (and hopefully make
better pathing decisions as a result).

Features include:

- Use the draw and eraser tools to map out your path - straight lines snap to the path you draw.
- Alternate map views - fit the entire map on screen vertically or horizontally.
- Automatic route analysis: how many elites / fires / events are there on each path?
- Improved gamepad support for the map features (left analog button to switch between draw and eraser tools, right trigger to switch between map views, scroll the map with the right analog stick (only if Steam Input is disabled))

Feedback and feature requests always welcome!

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-pathing-plus

Pathing Plus works on both the main branch (version 0.111.1) and the beta branch (version 0.113.1).
changeNote:
v1.9.1
- Fixed the route table going blank (and route analysis stopping) until you saved and reloaded. The mod was holding on to a font that the game frees between rooms.
- Fixed the map opening zoomed in when you had left it in a wide view, which happened alongside the bug above.
- The map no longer briefly turns upright when the game re-opens a map that's already open.
- View changes are now noted in the game log, to help track down any remaining reports.
